plan.title: bug: engine:_ts-build doubles DEFT_ROOT on Windows native — task deft:verify:cache-fresh fails

narratives.Description: bug: engine:_ts-build doubles DEFT_ROOT on Windows native — task deft:verify:cache-fresh fails
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

On **Windows native** (PowerShell / go-task, not WSL), `task deft:verify:cache-fresh` fails before the gate runs because the `engine:_ts-build` dependency doubles `DEFT_ROOT` into an invalid path. The same consumer project works under WSL and the underlying gate works via the global npm CLI (`deft preflight-cache`).

This breaks the AGENTS.md session-start ritual step 5 (`task verify:cache-fresh` / `task deft:verify:cache-fresh`) for Windows-native operators who have not previously exercised directive on that host.

Related but distinct from #2118 (CRLF phantom dirty tree after `deft update` on an already-current deposit).

## Environment

- **Consumer repo:** `deftai/statusreport` (master, directive v0.65.0 npm deposit)
- **OS:** Windows 10/11 native — PowerShell, **not WSL**
- **task:** go-task (Taskfile v3 include: `task deft:verify:cache-fresh`)
- **Global CLI:** `@deftai/directive@0.65.0` installed via `npm i -g @deftai/directive@latest`
- **First exercise on this host:** operator previously used directive only under WSL; first native-Windows run surfaced this

## Repro

```powershell
cd C:\Repos\Deft\statusreport   # clean master, v0.65.0 deposit
npm i -g @deftai/directive@latest
task deft:verify:cache-fresh
```

## Expected

Gate runs (or exits with a cache-freshness result). On a project with no triage bootstrap yet, `--allow-missing-bootstrap` should treat missing cache as fresh — same as direct CLI:

```powershell
deft preflight-cache --project-root . --allow-missing-bootstrap
# ✓ deft cache-fresh: no cache found (bootstrap state) -- treating as fresh.
```

## Actual

```
task: [deft:engine:_ts-build] set -eu
if [ -f packages/cli/dist/bin.js ]; then
  pnpm run build
fi

task: Failed to run task "deft:verify:cache-fresh":
  task: Failed to run task "deft:engine:_ts-build":
  could not stat: CreateFile C:\Repos\Deft\statusreport\.deft\core\C:\Repos\Deft\statusreport\.deft\core:
  The filename, directory name, or volume label syntax is incorrect.
```

`DEFT_ROOT` is concatenated twice when go-task resolves `dir: '{{.DEFT_ROOT}}'` for the included `engine:_ts-build` task on Windows native.

## Scope

`verify:cache-fresh` declares:

```yaml
deps:
  - task: :engine:_ts-build
```

`tasks/engine.yml`:

```yaml
_ts-build:
  dir: '{{.DEFT_ROOT}}'
```

Other `engine:invoke` gates that **omit** the `_ts-build` dep work on the same host — e.g. `task deft:doctor` succeeds and falls through to global `deft doctor`.

Any task depending on `:engine:_ts-build` via the cross-include `:engine:` prefix is likely affected on Windows native; `verify:cache-fresh` is the session-start / pre-`start_agent` gate called out in AGENTS.md.

## Workarounds

1. Use the global CLI directly: `deft preflight-cache --project-root . --allow-missing-bootstrap`
2. Run directive workflows under WSL (where this path doubling was not observed)
3. Session-start step 5 can be skipped only when operator accepts bypassing the gate (not ideal for agent dispatch)

## Proposed fix directions

1. Fix `engine:_ts-build` `dir` resolution on Windows when invoked as `:engine:_ts-build` from an included namespace (go-task path join / `DEFT_ROOT` expansion).
2. Or remove `_ts-build` as a hard dep for npm consumer deposits where `packages/cli/dist/bin.js` is intentionally absent — `_ts-build` is already a no-op when bin.js missing; the dep should not block `engine:invoke` fallback to global `deft`.
3. Add a Windows-native CI or smoke step that runs `task deft:verify:cache-fresh` on a consumer fixture (parity with WSL/Linux coverage).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `task deft:verify:cache-fresh` exits 0 on Windows native PowerShell for a v0.65.0 npm consumer deposit with global `deft` installed
- [ ] No doubled `DEFT_ROOT` path in go-task `dir` resolution
- [ ] `deft preflight-cache` and `task deft:verify:cache-fresh` remain behaviorally equivalent on Windows native
- [ ] Regression test or documented smoke for Windows-native consumer Taskfile includes

## Related

- #2118 — Windows CRLF phantom dirty tree after no-op `deft update` (separate issue)
- #2022 Phase 3 — Python-free npm deposit; `engine:invoke` + global `deft` fallback
- AGENTS.md session-start ritual step 5 (`task verify:cache-fresh`)
